THE INSULIN PUMP WILL BE RETURNED FOR THE ANALYSIS.

CUSTOMER STATED THAT THE BATTERY CAP WAS NOT LOOSE, CRACKED OR DAMAGED. THIS WAS THE SECOND OCCURRENCE OF REPLACE BATTERY ALERT OR REPLACE BATTERY NOW ALARM IN LESS THAN 8 HOURS AFTER A LOW BATTERY WARNING. NO HARM REQUI

DEVICE RECEIVED WITH BLANK DISPLAY DUE TO CORRODED ELECTRONIC ASSEMBLY. CORRODED BATTERY TUBE NOTED DURING VISUAL INSPECTION. UNABLE TO CONFIRM BATTERY ANOMALY DUE TO BLANK DISPLAY. DEVICE RECEIVED WITH MISSING RETAINER, MISSING RESERVOIR TUBE O-RING AND BROKEN RESERVOIR TUBE LIP. UNABLE TO PERFORM DISPLACEMENT TEST OR LOCK RESERVOIR OR P-CAP IN PLACE DUE TO MISSING RETAINER.
